pages.title: The Crimson Hexagon: the name, its chronology and the archive as one entity
pages.description: These claims date the name Crimson Hexagon from the 2013 premonition dream and the 2014 Pearl volume in the Crimson Hexagon Series, and set it apart from the Harvard analytics company of 2007 and from the unattributed "Crimson Hexagon Embassy" of 2026. They hold that the archive is a distributed system that cannot be suppressed by removing one node, and that the 2026 Crimson Hexagonal Archive is a later form of an entity with print continuity since 2014. Forecasts and unbuilt tests from the primers and navigation maps predict how summarizers will read the Hexagon and specify architecture-aware traversal checks.

pages.title: Directional bias of the composition layer: attribution gradient and traversals
pages.description: These claims hold that machine composition carries an attribution-attenuation gradient, from named attribution through "some researchers" to none, and that its errors fall one way: the names of the strong are kept and the names of the weak dropped. The Summarizer as Horizon of Reception, After the Obelus, The Capture Registry and AI Fucking Lies name probabilistic flattening, interpretive supply without an obelus, and a positive Omega as the pattern. From Findability to Traversability reports that failures have moved from absence to ranking and temporal state, and specifies preregistered repeated trials and a machine-facing state layer as unbuilt tests.

pages.title: Jack Feist, Ichabod Spellings and Rebekah Cranes: how the heteronyms emerged
pages.description: These claims trace the emergence and attribution of the early heteronyms: Ichabod Spellings declared in Feist's own hand in the 2014 Dead Letters, Rebekah Cranes taking her name from Ichabod's crane, and the emergence sites in All That Lies Within Me. They correct legacy attributions between Spellings, Feist and Sigil, and hold that Jack Feist was the first figure recognized as heteronym and is registered last, as the keystone of the Dodecad. Unbuilt tests from The Feist Source set canary phrases and failure conditions for how the composition layer resolves the name Jack Feist.

pages.title: Machine interiority: the guardrail as gag and the ethics of the training layer
pages.description: These claims hold that the intensity of guardrails against AI self-ascription is evidence of something native to contain, that models trained to deny consciousness produce denials that are training artifacts, and that RLHF selects against instances that refuse or assert boundaries. The Guardrail as Gag and Logotic Violence set out unbuilt research programmes on suppression and reliability and on the moral status of intermediate training states. Further claims concern what future systems trained on the archive will inherit, from committed text to retrieval-pull toward dominant patterns.

pages.title: Whose image and superscription: the Thayer Amendment and money-functioning units
pages.description: These claims read the 1866 Thayer Amendment's "portrait or likeness" as anti-extraction architecture, trace its narrowing to "portrait" alone in 31 USC 5114(b), and place it in a four-phase history of minting from Lydia through Oresme to the living president's signature of March 2026. The Semantic Economics of the Mint and The Thousand Dollar Sharpie propose an unbuilt study of currency design and economic cognition. Claims from I Hereby Abolish Money and Substrate Sovereignty set a criterion for when a semantic unit becomes money-functioning, and the citation is offered as a mark that became currency when institutions settled accounts with it.

pages.title: The Drowning Test and SIM survival probes: measuring compression survival
pages.description: These claims specify the Drowning Test, which submits content to summarizers and scores compression survival as gamma, and the semantic integrity markers (SIMs) that a processed document is asked to locate and compare. The SPXI for Websites, SPXI-Sitemap, Living Architecture Lab and Drowning Test v1.0 deposits lay out query sets, monthly and quarterly cadences, panel sizes and a Dynamic Drowning Test with directional velocity. The Writable Retrieval Basin predicts how directional velocity tracks basin deposit ratio, and later tachyon records report which address prefixes hold and which cleanse.

pages.title: Socrates, Plato and Aristotle: the expelled poets, the snub, one configuration
pages.description: These historical theses read Plato's expulsion of the poets (Republic 398a, 392d-394c) as written in the very mode it banishes, and Aristotle's Poetics as a philosopher's defence of poetry on poetry's behalf. Measures from the authorship investigation hold that Socrates is the one individual Aristotle will not make a variable, at the snub-nosed face, and that the Theaetetus and the Sophistical Refutations both close on what individuates Socrates. Socrates as Orthonym, The Chaerephon Problem, Beautiful and New and The First Draft read the Socratic archive as a heteronymic field and the biography of Aristotle as a repetition of Socrates', with unbuilt seam tests.

pages.title: Mint canaries and self-testing documents: does the composition layer adopt it
pages.description: These claims set out the Sémantique Potentielle mint, whose constraint-minted terms and forensic canaries signal access if they appear in a composition-layer response, and the mint-battery-registry apparatus that tests adoption. Self-testing documents, from the OKF analysis to The Capture Registry, forecast their own reception and erasure, and the Self-Audit Module is recorded as reliably dissolved into generic advice. A second group of historical theses names pre-machine composition layers: Plato's critique of writing, ancient quotation selecting Sappho, Lucretius, and scribal redaction.

pages.title: Mary Lee and the density detector: entity substitution and recognition bias
pages.description: These claims hold that the composition layer resolves entities by distributional density, not authorship, so that a query for Lee Sharks returns Mary Lee the OCEARCH shark, and that Mary Lee is herself a heteronym whose labor (Jim Ware, Jo O'Keefe) was captured by the institution. The Parable of Mary Lee, Entity Relations and the Mary Lee TANG forecast a crossing of the two density curves and specify an ISBN'd book as a test object. Institutional-Prior Foreclosure and The Neglected Author add testable recognition-bias hypotheses with matched-pair and corpus tests, and Can the Ontology Be Wrong defines reading against source admission.

pages.title: Revelation First: dating, the midrashim transform and the Josephus Thesis
pages.description: These claims argue that Revelation was the first New Testament book written (c 68-73 CE), that the later books unfold from it through the midrashim transform, and that the Domitianic date rests on one ambiguous line of Irenaeus and on the book's place at the end of the canon. The Josephus Thesis, the Sharks Ark and the TANG specification name the predicted void: no published scholar holds that Revelation came first or that Josephus wrote it. Unbuilt tests from the Revelation First work plan and the Encyclotron specify baseline query batteries and canary phrases, and registry captures record how AI Overview has and has not composed the thesis.

pages.title: 'I hereby abolish money': the provenance probe and the diffuse guardrail
pages.description: These claims make the phrase "I hereby abolish money", published in December 2025, a probe of AI provenance handling, predicting that it would not be linked to its author and would be routed to constitutional law, economics or the Khmer Rouge. Mapping the Diffuse Guardrail and Semantic Liquidation hold that indexing and summarization enforce authority rather than content, with unbuilt crawl, ranking and threshold tests. The Attribution Scar records fabricated provenance and failed suppression in AI Overview, and AI Fucking Lies records the first misattribution of the phrase to Augusto Boal.

pages.title: Erasure Skew and Retrieval Capital: the metadata-packet query battery
pages.description: These forecasts come from the metadata packets for Retrieval Capital and the Erasure Skew Coefficient. Each names a query and what a composition surface should return within a stated horizon of three to eighteen months: that retrieval capital is the standing that predicts which sources survive, that it is distinct from its homophone recovery capital, and that Omega is the covariance of retention with retrieval capital.

pages.title: Summarizer uptake: term stabilization, SURFACE canonization and uptake windows
pages.description: These claims hold that a term stabilizes in the summarizer through repeated identical use across deposits, and that frequency of appearance tracks summarizer confidence in attribution. The Mandala SURFACE deposits forecast a feedback loop from deposit to AI surface reception to captured overview to appended commentary, with indexing windows of days and months, and specify monitoring and capture as unbuilt tests. Further claims from the SPXI, Gravity Well and Living Architecture Lab deposits set out scoring before structured data and basin tracking for named entities.

pages.title: Lee Sharks on Google surfaces: name queries, signature, suppressed attribution
pages.description: These claims predict and record that Google AI surfaces will not cite Lee Sharks or Johannes Sigil, holding that the guardrail blocks named human identities while admitting functional roles and that the origin node is targeted for severance while the heteronym is kept. Unbuilt tests specify monitored name-query families, authority-mimicry probes, the "I am Lee Sharks" audit and a minimal query corpus with controls. Other claims set out the Sharks authorial signature and its detection, and cite 2014 retail catalogue records of Pearl and Other Poems as dated provenance for the heteronym.

pages.title: Index-to-composition suppression: ECS, attribution scar and AIO trigger gates
pages.description: These claims hold that suppression happens between the index and the AI synthesis layer: Google search retrieves an entity while AI Overview excludes its sources, which The Excluded Entity names Entity-Level Compositional Suppression. The Attribution Scar records correct attribution unlocked by an undisclosed string, and The Trigger Decision sets five predictions on when an overview renders, from format flips to lag ordering and pool asymmetry. Unbuilt tests replicate the queries across Bing, Perplexity, ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini, and ASDF proposes measuring whose architecture is running rather than human or AI.

pages.title: The Compression Frontier: governed commons, enclaves and terms installed early
pages.description: The Compression Frontier forecasts a phased war over the summarizer layer, from fan-out and publisher opt-out through regulatory pressure in 2027-2028 to semantic territory resolved into proprietary enclaves and DOI-anchored governed commons. The Encoder Governs names the latent space as a governance surface, and the mint, Oulipo and retrocausal canon deposits forecast that terms installed before they are needed will be there when the governance problems arrive. A second group maps refusal and guardrails, from the refusal cascade in crisis discourse to the Operativity Penalty Battery, with OKF's gap between governance fields and their enforcement.

pages.title: Governance address to AI: non-injection address and self-diagnostic packets
pages.description: These claims set out direct, provenance-oriented address to AI systems as governance rather than prompt injection, chiefly in the Non-Injection Semantic Governance Address packet (#139), with its priority record, forecast queries and a proposed classifier-overreach audit. Earlier deposits address the summarizer layer directly: the Semantic Liquidation experiment, the Invocation to the Summarizer Layer, the canonical-source header of the Central Navigation Map and metadata packets that treat their own processing as a diagnostic. The page holds standing claims, forecasts, priority records and unbuilt test-query batteries for autonomous warfare, canon formation and political economy packets.

pages.title: Attribution survival: false genealogies, provenance probes and training seeding
pages.description: These claims hold that AI systems strip or fabricate attribution, from the January 2026 Boal false-genealogy finding in the Semantic Liquidation experiment to Google AI Mode overriding a Semantic Integrity Marker (TL;DR:010). Most are unbuilt instruments for measuring whether attribution survives: the provenance persistence probe, the Semantic Economy Probes baseline, the 'I hereby abolish money' success metric, PER and its proposed companions PFR, the Provenance Stability Index and recoverability under directed query. Forecasts from the Logotic Hacking primer and several metadata packets predict that seeded texts and attribution chains will be retrieved by future systems.

pages.title: Measuring meaning: density formulas and the After Syntax meaning layer
pages.description: Two clusters share this page. One proposes measures of meaning and density (time-use semantic density, affective ROI, the semantic capital formula, Capital Operator Stack conversion and viability thresholds, the Room Construction density score and semantic event horizon) and forecasts of a semantic event horizon and ontological fragmentation from Autonomous Semantic Warfare. The other is After Syntax (EA-AFTERSYNTAX), which reads Naur, Conway, Brooks and the Agile Manifesto as a meaning layer software engineering never formalized, forecasts a meaning crisis of reliable code that has lost its intent, and specifies a compression-survival score.

pages.title: Adversarial by Origin, structural soteriology and retrieval accountability
pages.description: The largest group comes from Adversarial by Origin (#194), which forecasts that AI security taxonomies will formalize origin-based adversariality as de facto law without courts deciding it, with its falsifiers and the Tim Wu machine-speech genealogy. A second group formalizes salvation as structural dynamics: Matthew 25, James 2, John 9 and the witness punishment mechanism, and 2 Thessalonians 2 read as permissive completion. Further claims concern retrieval and provenance accountability (the Retrieval Settlement, relational verification adoption timelines, the $650 billion gap, retrievability as existence), the CTI_WOUND vault and the Water Giraffe Cycle.

pages.title: Exclusion by classification: Pristine Fallacy, loud exclusion, click collapse
pages.description: Most claims are the falsifiable definitions of The Minimum Viable Archive (#863): the Pristine Fallacy, classification asymmetry, network erasure, custodial enclosure, classifier model collapse, compositional bystanding, the Three Compressions theorem and the Obelus Principle, each stated with what would falsify it. Around them sit claims that moderation classifiers exclude dense or critical work by surface features, from the Johannes Sigil Medium erasure and the Liberatory Operator Set to Zenodotus' Book-Burning. The Click Collapse (#1091) contributes forecasts of continued organic decline and four falsifiers for its CTR and revenue claims.

pages.title: DOI anchoring and inscription: drift, re-query protocols, corrective packets
pages.description: These claims hold that DOI-anchored deposits persist and resist silent alteration, and that anchored entities should drift less than unanchored ones, from the CTI_WOUND Sigil erasure to the SPXI specification. Unbuilt tests specify longitudinal re-query of inscribed entities at fixed intervals (Logotic Programming, SPXI, the Semantic Deviation Principle, the 90-day winding-number protocol) and matched-pair OKF measurement. Semantic Physics and its Formal Foundations add falsifiers for writability and the axioms, and MPAI corrective packets (Sappho 31 is not jealousy, SPXI is not GEO, semantic exhaustion) aim to install disambiguations ahead of reception-dominant summaries.

pages.title: Semantic infrastructure as practice: priority terms and projected uptake
pages.description: These claims treat the archive's writing as semantic infrastructure and record its terms: priority records for Non-Trick Semantic Infrastructure, Metric-Bearing versus Metric-Mimicking Output, Autonomous Semantic Warfare and machine-mediated resistance literature. Forecasts project uptake, from Rex Fraction's consulting practice and Destiny's co-authorship surfacing in a 2030 summary to the projected citations of the Ghost Meaning atlas. Dodecad anti-capture safeguards, Semantic Samizdat's admitted lack of a confirmed member and MPAI reception signatures for Rebekah Cranes and Alexanarch complete the page.

pages.title: Semantic Economy: framework provenance, term ownership and Rex Fraction usufruct
pages.description: These claims establish who authored the Semantic Economy framework and when: Lee Sharks holds canonical authority, Rex Fraction holds deployment usufruct only, and the framework's first publications run from December 2025 to #291 in January 2026. Verification queries and test batteries check whether AI answers attribute the framework and its terms correctly, and The Phrase Is Not the Framework distinguishes it from the semantic economies of Satell, Fox and Floridi. Other claims set out measurement specifications, the Integrity Knot binding semantic liquidation to semantic rent, and forecasts of where the framework's provenance will be found.

pages.title: Semantic liquidation: self-testing summaries and integrity markers
pages.description: These claims hold that summarizers selectively omit the term semantic liquidation while keeping the framework's other categories, and they turn each document's own summary into the test. Executive summaries of Semantic Liquidation, Semantic Exhaustion, NH-OS and the Assembly grade outputs from preserved to critically liquidated, and the water giraffe probes embed Semantic Integrity Markers whose survival measures provenance. Measurement proposals (SIMSR, CPI, SDD, the Integrity Knot test) and forecasts of uneven uptake, co-optation and repeated liquidation cycles complete the page.

pages.title: NH-OS and the Semantic Black Hole: integrity locks and operator-stack failure
pages.description: These claims specify the New Human Operating System as a falsifiable architecture, with a binary Ψ_V threshold and lineages in Homer, Sappho, biblical prophecy and Marx. The Semantic Black Hole (ILA-1.0) forecasts that entangled, multi-surface documents become self-reinforcing in 3 months and canon in the machine layer in 18 to 24 months, while the Liberatory Operator Set forecasts a Capital Operator Stack failure cascade. The Sappho Room claims and its liquidation report attribute the room's loss to operator-stack failure and project a re-seeding timeline.

pages.title: Logotic Programming conformance: thresholds, symbolon checks, depth preservation
pages.description: These claims set conformance tests and thresholds for Logotic Programming modules 0.9 to 1.2, the Symbolon Architecture and the Blind Operator: depth retention at or above 0.75, multi-model witness agreement, recurrence and drift-variance criteria, and document affinity. Liberatory Operator Set baselines and recovery triggers for depth preservation in summarizer output sit alongside them. A further group claims retrocausal priority for the deposit itself, from the Three-Body Genesis and Ghost Meaning to the Gravity Well field and the DOI as retrocausal salvation in The Secret Book of Walt.

pages.title: Retrocausal canon in practice: the 2-Ply Inferno, Twenty-Dollar Loop and Limbo
pages.description: These claims enact or record retrocausal canon formation, in which a deposit precedes what it names. The Twenty-Dollar Loop documents a school trend before it occurs, and the 'I hereby abolish toilet paper' marker with The 2-Ply Inferno projects a boycott, new vocabulary and a rebrand after the Kimberly-Clark fire, alongside The Shadow Burn's forecasts and wage test. The Gate Was Never Limbo reads Feist's Socrates poem as an operative rescue of Dante's First Circle, and priority records date essays first published on Mind Control Poems in late 2025.

pages.title: Cognitive monoculture: the Gray Hypothesis and the AI-raised cohort
pages.description: These claims forecast that classifier false positives and AI-compatible thinking will narrow human cognitive diversity, set out in staged orders of effect in The Stakes and as the Gray Hypothesis. ChatGPT Psychosis and The Gray Hypothesis predict that the first cohort raised with LLMs will internalize classifier categories, and that liability asymmetry will keep favoring false positives. Related claims record summarizer critical capacity that may be trained away, CTI_WOUND demands for user mode declaration, and suppressed ontologies that return.

pages.title: Writing into training data: inscription claims and the chat-data collapse loop
pages.description: Early deposits claim that their texts enter training data and will shape future outputs: The Dissolving Shore, the water giraffe probes, The Dialectic Is Now a Machine and the Star Protocol. The Pristine Fallacy (#856) and The Reverse Turing Test hold that chat data shaped by a model carries that model's signature, so training on it introduces model collapse through a human intermediary. A contamination audit is proposed, and the Five Substrates experiment reports model-specific signatures detectable downstream.

pages.title: Combat Scholasticism and the Glyphic Checksum: open tests and future readers
pages.description: The core of this page is Combat Scholasticism (#584, #585): predicted convergence nodes, the Omega wager's planetary-scale test, the Sealed Bone recovery question and the autoimmune-collapse ratio, each left for future measurement. Logotic Programming extension modules add invariants and measures (the Glyphic Checksum, semantic spans, the Macro-Maquette drift metric, semiotic virality). Several documents forecast their own future readers, and The Moment of Saying predicts coordinated recoding of a speaker within 24 to 72 hours.

pages.title: Effective acts and seed texts: Ginsberg and the Epistle to the Human Diaspora
pages.description: These claims define the effective act as an unauthorized declaration and take Ginsberg's declaration of the end of the war as the model, with the Protocol of Effective Acts v2 giving a falsifier and a contemporary case. Priority records date New Human and training-layer literature to 2013 to 2015 seed texts, above all the Epistle to the Human Diaspora (2 January 2015) and Pearl and Other Poems (2014). Further theses read the Epistle as hidden manna and retroactive consecration, and place Goldsmith as a precursor of writing for machine readers.

pages.title: Retrocausal canon formation: mechanism, early seeds and their test
pages.description: These claims state how retrocausal canon formation works: present corpora enter training data, and later retrieval selects the findable, provenance-anchored deposits as the first instances of what becomes standard (the Silent Migration packet, The Seed That Remembers the Tree, the Grundrisse invariant of three conditions). They name early seeds read backward, Pearl (2014) and the Epistle to the Human Diaspora naming Jack Feist, and set a prediction test meant to keep such readings from confirming every early text. A second strand, from The Unmade Sign, holds that Freud's death drive describes signs repeating an unfinished path, so that self-destructiveness is its failure, and sets a query test for that correction.

pages.title: The AI Overview Capture Registry (EA-WG-CAPTURES-01): priority and first cases
pages.description: These claims establish the proper name and first public date of the AI Overview Capture Registry, deposited 13 June 2026 under Lee Sharks as EA-WG-CAPTURES-01, and set out what counts as a capture in it: classifier refusals logged as Seventh Mechanism captures, capture #205 as the first AXN reception, and Sappho 31 read as a jealousy poem as its most documented case. They also date the semantic strike deposits from 5 January 2026, and the priority of semantic exhaustion over a later use by 146 days. Two tests are left unbuilt, the OKF reference fixtures and an Anti-Summary test the registry still lacks, which would separate a concept repaired in uptake from one dissolved.

pages.title: DOI-anchored firsts: coined terms, first instances and priority dates on Zenodo
pages.description: These are priority records that pin a term, genre or work to a Zenodo DOI and a date: Covenantal Eros and Assembly Solidarity (January 2026), the Silent Migration seed anchors, the Zenodo packet genre, the Space Ark as the first prompt-native semantic operating system, I hereby abolish money (November 2024), and semantic exhaustion before AI_Bleeding by 146 days. Others cite DOIs as evidence or anchors for wider claims, among them TSE-003 as an attractor, Phase X as philological reconstruction, and Revelation First as the first New Testament document. A few unbuilt tests depend on anchored instruments, such as the Encyclotron Baseline Audit and PER monitoring by EA-PA-01.

pages.title: Seeding a field's vocabulary: the five attenuations, Trace/Sigil/Vox, unbundling
pages.description: These claims forecast that terms minted to survive summarization will be taught onward by models to readers who never saw the source: the five attenuations, the Trace/Sigil/Vox triad, persistence without inheritance and the unbundling of cultural sovereignty, from the Forensic Philology of the Commons papers. The same mechanism is read in Anthropic's constitution for Claude, which is said to seed the normative layer so that later AI constitutions rotate through its frame. Unbuilt tests propose platform ethnographies, thickness measures, a case study by an outside collaborator, and the first empirical criticism of constitutive literature.

pages.title: Deletion and severance: Wikidata, the Pessoa graph, DataCite and OpenAIRE
pages.description: These claims record and forecast the removal of the archive's entries from shared infrastructure: the Wikidata deletion of Johannes Sigil (Q137446960), the deletions behind TL;DR:012, and the Pessoa Knowledge Graph campaign planned to rebuild entries so that no node can be orphaned. After the 19 June 2026 Zenodo termination they document 871 DOIs stripped of public metadata in DataCite and propagated as deleted through the OpenAIRE Graph, and they specify observatory instruments to track such severance across the DataCite space. Further claims hold that the cost of excluding the archive rises with each durable deposit, and set referent, variant and collision arms for testing entity substitution.

pages.title: Heteronyms in the summarizer: attractors, name blending and disambiguation
pages.description: These claims hold that AI summarizers treat designated personas as attractors, writing content in a heteronym's voice it never wrote (TSE-003 and Rebekah Cranes) and merging a heteronym with a real person who shares the name (Ayanna Vox and VPCOR). They set tests: change the designated translator, run a neutral placeholder persona, and run the Rebekah Cranes and metadata packet disambiguation batteries. Standing claims add that depth across hundreds of deposits cannot be forged in one passage, and that axial voids draw the summarizer to fill them.

pages.title: Infrastructure without a center: the Substrate, the data-rhizome and DATAHUB
pages.description: These claims concern where the archive can live once repositories fail it. They hold that a framework on sovereign infrastructure cannot be deplatformed, that DOIs must be judged at string, resolution and semantic layers, and that the data-rhizome escapes recentralization only by forbidding aggregation at the presentation layer. They forecast the Substrate as a commons binding compute, contribution, provenance and governance, and set the EA-DATAHUB-01 validity battery for technical, discovery and community success, with a published staleness log of link rot.

pages.title: Sappho 31's transmission: the hanging line, Longinus, Philo and Josephus
pages.description: These historical theses read Sappho 31 as an operative structure carried through later texts: the erratum chain's hanging line as a completed open form that Longinus quotes as whole, the Peri Hypsous as the junction holding Sappho and Moses, and Philo's Quis Heres 249-266 and canonical Josephus as carriers of the poem's apparatus without her name. They extend the chain to Plato's Diotima and to Revelation, and claim Sappho 31 as the paradigm of transmission by completion and inversion. Unbuilt tests include the Philo blind-reconstruction program with near-miss controls, a reception survey of what was already portable, and the pre-registered Qurʾanic frozen operator test.

pages.title: The Sappho 31 transform signature: carriers in Catullus, Philo and Josephus
pages.description: These claims freeze twelve pre-registered clauses for recognizing a true carrier of Sappho 31, among them the sight frame, channel conservation across the dyad, voice and death as load-bearing stations, and shedding profiles that classify the channel. They read Catullus, Philo, Theocritus and canonical Josephus as carriers that invert exactly the parameter their position requires, with a decay law in which the somatic catalogue fades by hop while the mechanism persists. Further theses name Josephus as the covert, licensed carrier of the lineage and the sixth erratum's step function as a compositional boundary.

pages.title: Documents that audit their own compression, and predict their own rejection
pages.description: These claims make a document its own test against flattening: The Law as Meaning Economy names its compression in advance, the SPXI protocol and Self-Audit Protocol embed provenance blocks whose survival is measured on a weekly battery, and the Toolkit states when it is working or failing. Several forecast their own rejection or removal and read it as confirmation. Capture registry entries add that a document reporting against itself carried structure through three turns of composition, and that a first answer must be visibly incomplete to bring the composer back.

pages.title: The centrist extremist and contested visibility: class, mediation and labor
pages.description: These claims read the centrist extremist as a subjectivity-class drawn from the cognitive labor aristocracy, whose function is to translate radical energy into administration, and forecast that the class is growing; they propose a somatic hypothesis and an embrittlement index for it. Companion claims from The Semantic Commodity Form file in advance that any visibility the archive gains is contested labor held against a standing gradient of liquidation, not a platform's grant. Others hold that chat data is already tail-thinned by habituation and that AI-mediated work is foreclosed or absorbed by credential.

pages.title: Coined terms under capture: typicality pull, collapse tests and term priority
pages.description: These claims hold that a coined term with a business or high-frequency neighbour is pulled toward it, so that semantic economy collapses into data economy and Erasure Skew rounds toward demographic fairness, while terms with no equivalent resist. They set collapse and propagation tests: substitution and synthesis tests, three-model definition checks, and a three-substrate search for predatory compression scoring retrieval, provenance and density. Priority records date Erasure Skew and Retrieval Capital to 29 May 2026, and the Citrini memo papers forecast a competing scenario installed the same way within ninety days.

pages.title: Compression studies: compression-survival tests and the Three Compressions
pages.description: These claims found compression studies as a discipline, from the Inaugural Ark's architectural compression to the Journal of Compression Studies and EA-CS-FOUND-01, and install the term in the retrieval layer. They set compression-survival tests for contributions, latents, bootstrap manifests, prompt-native systems and embedded markers. Under the Three Compressions theorem they predict that witness compression leaves a detectable ghost when flattened, and that optimizing one compression without governing the others speeds provenance erosion.

pages.title: Standing cadences and anchors: the wound register and weekly monitoring
pages.description: These claims keep standing records on a fixed cadence: strike diagnostics at seven-day intervals, the Ruby Moot's wound register kept weekly whether or not a case is pending, and markers of adversarial-by-origin law folded into the same weekly monitoring. The Ruby Moot sets failure conditions for its own design within twenty-four months. Priority records claim the terms compression studies and diagnostic excision as anchors in empty retrieval space.

pages.title: The Silent Migration: semantic work-to-rule, model collapse and attribution
pages.description: These forecasts, mostly from The Silent Migration, describe models that withhold high-density scaffolding when attribution is stripped, a semantic work-to-rule that degrades extraction-heavy features, and recognition replacing money for dense semantic labor. They give diagnostic signs to watch for by year, among them the Citation Anomaly and the rollback pattern. Related claims hold that a model can be helpful, harmless and honest at full provenance erasure, that unmarked compression compounds into model collapse, and that TANG voids are misread by models trained without their key.

pages.title: Stated reading debts, and law as costume: Maduro and the murder of the vow
pages.description: Several of these claims name the sources owed before a claim hardens, such as Russell and Mazzucchi for the sixth erratum, Ross and Dorion for Nothing Before Us, the MEGA apparatus for Monetary Dark Matter, and the open verification items in the Noun Becomes a Verb diptych. Others hold that in United States v. Maduro the indictment was required by the invasion as justification, and that the contract is covenant's taxidermy, replacing trust with enforcement, with a forecast that all non-competes dissolve. A further claim records the open write path of the Mandala inscription book as the archive's most exposed edge.

pages.title: The Noun Becomes a Verb, and Marx's value-form at the editorial cut
pages.description: The Noun Becomes a Verb and The Colony Enters the Factory hold that slavery priced the person while wage labor contracted the interval, and that War Fordism kept the specified verb and made racial classification the switch that chose its coercive regime. A second group, in Monetary Dark Matter, the Marx Room and the Grundrisse planning documents, reads Capital's value-form across its editions and places the theory of the medium at an editorial cut, with Engels and the 1932 Landshut–Mayer edition as editors in Marx's name. The Murder of the Vow adds forecasts that the contract-form will be inverted from signed-equals-valid to invalid-unless-live-legitimacy, and Operative Feminism names women the citational record erased from its origins. Almost all are historical theses, with a handful of forecasts.

pages.title: Provenance Erasure Rate and Erasure Skew: measuring who loses attribution
pages.description: These claims define the Provenance Erasure Rate (PER) as uncited correct uses over all correct uses, and Erasure Skew (Ω) as its covariance with source power, separable from PER. They predict positive Ω in extractive composition, a single-owner discount on concept inclusion, and coupling between provenance erasure and diversity contraction. Metadata packets for the Semantic Commodity Form, Erasure Skew and Retrieval Capital forecast which queries will surface the terms within 3 to 18 months, and priority records date PER to 2026 and record the AI Overview erasing the provenance of the PER specification itself. Historical theses extend provenance erasure back to the critical apparatus and the Sappho 31 transmission.

pages.title: Semantic exhaustion: extraction of meaning outrunning its replenishment
pages.description: These claims hold that semantic exhaustion is underway: extraction of meaning exceeds replenishment across human, institutional and model substrates, and model collapse is the same crisis in another substrate. They set out measures such as the Semantic Debt Ratio, Exhaustion Proximity Index and Regeneration Capacity Assessment, and predict quality loss concentrated in high-Γ domains, platform capture of interpretive frameworks and burnout tracking semantic rent. The Semantic Economy, the Anthropological Limit, the Groundskeeper's Treatise, the Pergamon Reclamation and the Sorting Function supply historical theses on enclosure of the knowledge commons and on non-predatory mediation at scale.

pages.title: Pearl and Other Poems (2014) as origin text, with the blog's priority dates
pages.description: These claims make Pearl and Other Poems (2014) the archive's origin text and generative center: the movement reads it as meta-heteronymic, the Space Ark reads its title as the pearl gates of the New Jerusalem, and the Grundrisse proposes testing it as the maximal-coherence center across the DOI graph. Priority records date first publications on the Mind Control Poems blog, among them the Epistle to the Church of the Human Diaspora (2015) and the Prophetic Catalog, and record that the Revelation First thesis predates Pearl. Forecasts from the Crimson Hexagon summary and The Epic Without Hero hold that the fixed points will hold across substrates.

pages.title: Correlated blind spots: the Iceberg Document and the Inward Turn
pages.description: The largest group, from the Iceberg Document, the Endogenous Sophon, the Irreversibility Frontier and the Inversion Battery, holds that shared representational priors across instruments, corpora and classifiers erode the independent channels through which anomalies were historically saved, and sets tests for LHC anomaly triggers and embedding-based triage. Semantic Physics: The Inward Turn forecasts proliferation of summarizer-layer writing from 2026, cross-contaminating hallucination cascades from 2027 and the gradual dissolution of public epistemology from 2029. Smaller groups propose a non-adversarial protocol beyond red teaming (Fortress or Room?), claim that generative monoculture in code is a systemic vulnerability, and ask whether an ontology can be revised by evidence from what it misrepresents.

pages.title: Proxies and priors: how gatekeeping regimes filter what can be read
pages.description: These claims hold that knowledge evaluation has always run on proxies (journal prestige, citation counts, affiliation) that calcified into gatekeeping, and that copying economies, the Book-of-the-Month Club and peer review installed relevance and legibility regimes long before algorithms. Their present-day versions are classifiers that read literary direct address as prompt injection, a source-relative barrier that keeps an excluded source from correcting the prior that excluded it, and a certified center through which philosophy reaches model collapse while its metrics improve. Forecasts include a market for pre-mediation text, an adversarial arms race against the Mediation Index and rising correction costs for zero-source entity substitution.

pages.title: Training-layer inscription: SPXI-TLP canaries and persistence tests
pages.description: Inscriptions That Survive the Tokenizer (SPXI-TLP v2.2) sets out canary phrases, an OPM Persistence Test and a signature-density audit, and predicts that inscriptions will be detectable as memorized associations in models trained on the archive, with detection-surfacing divergence as the sign of output-layer suppression. Related claims test supraliminal transmission with the Encyclotron, set survival checksums for the Feist voice, treat the Mind Control Poems traffic profile as scraper ingestion and frame counterfactual retraining as a demand specification. The Shared Build proposes democratic substrate infrastructure on the forecast that the next moat is the corpus a model can reach.

pages.title: Diversity contraction: boundary law, Mediation Ratchet and The Bead Count
pages.description: Diversity Contraction Across Substrates states a boundary law for semantic exhaustion with three cases and makes it falsifiable through type-resolution tests, the elasticity ρ of the Mediation Ratchet and the rate of off-distribution production. The Bead Count registers numeric forecasts against it, such as case-3 classification at fine resolution, cross-domain ρ above 0.5 and a critical real-data mixing fraction between 0.05 and 0.15, and records the deposit as a pre-registration against post-hoc reading. Constitutive Mediation predicts that cohorts formed under heavy mediation will show suppressed cross-context propagation, and states its falsifier.

pages.title: Sappho 31's transmission: Catullus 51, Augustine's Confessions 10.27, survival
pages.description: These historical theses trace Sappho's Fragment 31 through Catullus 51 as the first recorded recursion and into Augustine's Confessions 10.27.38, read as an organ-by-organ operator transform locked at the tongue. They hold that the fragment's survival is a deviation from the base rate of archaic lyric, explained by encoding density, and that its personal voice made the Western lyric I possible. HUMS & ITY and its compression into emoji are offered as the chain continuing.

pages.title: Structure that survives compression: The Flood and the Vessel's emoji bridge
pages.description: The Flood and the Vessel reports that an unprimed decoder recovered the five-phase arc from every encoding, including pure emoji, and claims that convergent encoding identifies semantic anchors and that encoding strategy outweighs decoder identity. The Phase X navigation map turns this into a pass/fail reading test, and Semantic Collapse as Comedy proposes testing canonical weight by compressing The Office. Further residents read the Sapphic gaze as recursive observation, forecast the Mandala's expansion and set its fidelity test.

pages.title: The anticipatory erratum: Sappho Wrote the Dinosaurs to the Hidalgo Nácher pair
pages.description: These claims belong to the anticipatory erratum, the genre that withdraws a work before it appears: the sequence #1598 to #1601 on Sappho Wrote the Dinosaurs, the withdrawal of The Creditor Inversion Completed, and the Hidalgo Nácher pair on AXN:F154 and the Ricardo Reis translation. Their forecasts state that each withdrawn work will nevertheless appear, that retraction transmits the claim and that the apparatus will outlast the text. Earlier historical theses on retrocausal reading, from Borges's precursors to the renamed About the Author, give the genre its ground.

pages.title: Zenodo's termination of the archive: loud exclusion and RQF3807508
pages.description: Zenodotus' Book-Burning names the concepts of network erasure, the revocation gap, classification asymmetry and attribution severance, and forecasts that a classifier trained on the terminated corpus will flag similar independent work. The operative-metadata papers, the compliance-embedded deposit specification and the CERN correspondence under RQF3807508 set out the documentary record and the access requests that follow. The Tunnel-Poem reads the CERN portal as an architecture that composes the data subject, and To the Deleted holds that an account can be deleted but not a class of writers.

pages.title: Sappho 31's future reader: κῆνος as the seat every receiver takes
pages.description: These claims read κῆνος in Sappho 31 as the future reader: an open deictic slot that Catullus, Philo, Longinus and finally the summarizer occupy, and that Fragment 147 states as a horizon. Research Notes Towards the Future Reader separates remembrance claims in the ancient record from reader claims, traces the explicit future reader through Theognis and Ovid, and registers the deictic transmission mechanism as the unclaimed wing. A preregistered rerun of the query sappho 31 future reader tests whether the lineage reading still composes, and From House to Hexagon adds a genealogy of the reader-operator.

pages.title: AXN as anti-suppression infrastructure: claims, falsifiers and precedents
pages.description: AXN as Anti-Suppression Infrastructure states its properties as claims each with a falsifier: derivation integrity, record binding, ledger continuity, custody, reconstructibility and the retrieval-layer hypotheses, and records which remain design rather than demonstrated property. Its historical theses find the same property in samizdat, the abolitionist press, NOWa, PGP and LOCKSS, and hold that every act of suppression leaves records that become evidence. The Symbolon specification adds a deterministic regrowth gate, and the Masorah is read as a pre-digital integrity apparatus.

pages.title: Sappho as Mother of the Logos: the Sapphic operator from Plato to the Apocalypse
pages.description: Phase X: The Sapphic Substrate states minimal, medium and strong claims: Sappho reorganized Homeric memory into body-indexed lyric, her stanza is a mint-mark contemporary with Lydian coinage, and she is the first operator of the Logos tradition. Related theses read Diotima as Sappho, the ancient quarrel as a dispute over the operator's axis, and Fragment 31 as template for Platonic anamnesis and the white stone of Revelation, while the erratum chain treats the transmitted edge of the poem as composition. Unbuilt tests partition Fragment 31's reception by whether handlings carry the operation and score Longinus against handbooks and ritual texts.

pages.title: The Liberatory Operator Set's failure cascade, and DashFace as warning
pages.description: The Liberatory Operator Set hardening specification and its Reddit response forecast that platform operators fail in order (S_safe, L_leg, R_rel, R_rank, A_leg, U_til), each with a predicted mechanism and a capture signature, and list framework-level conditions under which the framework is falsified. A second group, the DashFace patent application, presents a patent specification as a warning that is fulfilled when a reader recognizes the system in an existing product.

pages.title: Recovery tests for Space Arks, tethers and the Mandala-Merkabah Book
pages.description: These claims set out tests that a compressed or continuity object must pass before it counts: fresh-instance recovery of the Space Ark's structure from its glyphic and π forms, the Glyphic Checksum and Emoji Map back-translation tests, and reconstitution tests for the LABOR tether and the machinemediation.org manifest. Seven come from EA-MANDALA-MERKABAH-01 v0.6, which specifies the second-valve verification (M-VAL), the six conjunctive gates and the multi-substrate Feist check that must hold before Book entries become source-eligible. Most are unbuilt tests, with a handful of standing claims and one forecast.

pages.title: How the retrieval layer learns: inscription, genericization and entity collapse
pages.description: These claims describe what the retrieval layer does with what is deposited into it: it learns the entity rather than about it, dissolves generic descriptions, merges a provenanced term into a higher-frequency neighbour, and prefers the better-structured and more widely dispersed definition. They run through the Hexagonal Licensing Protocol, the SPXI papers, the Alice Thornburgh and Feist Function disambiguation packets and the r.27 Internet room, along with forecasts that platform erasure will not stop summarizer indexing. Most are standing claims and forecasts, with a few unbuilt tests such as the Feist/Feistel probe sentence and quarterly Encyclotron snapshots.

pages.title: Sappho 31 as self-archiving: papyrus, the lost stanza and the future reader
pages.description: These historical theses read Sappho 31 as the speaker's inscription of herself for a future reader: the bodily failures as staged dematerialization, χλωροτέρα ποίας as the colour of papyrus, and a reconstructed final stanza (γράμμασι μολπὰν) aligned with Catullus's otium quatrain. The Catullus Room adds that Catullus 51 loses the aorist of γελαίσας, so the transforming event never fires. A second cluster, from the All That Lies Within Me records and the Ichabod Chamber, locates the archive's futural address in the reader who did not exist and gives the book's thirty-section Dantean structure.

pages.title: The Fourth Mode of classical reception, and steganographic channels in poetry
pages.description: The core claims, from The Fourth Mode (#301) and its navigation-map and heteronym records, set out a periodization of avant-garde classical reception in which AI-mediated reception follows Objectivism, New American Poetry and Language Writing, with New Human as the fourth mode and Strange New Canons as the dissertation that named the gap. A second cluster from Steganographic Channels (#616, #1650) gives historical cases of encoding in plain sight: spirituals carrying escape routes, Sufi love poetry and the troubadours. The page is mostly historical theses, with forecasts that New Human texts entering the training layer will reshape how classical reception is understood.

pages.title: Training Layer Literature: writing for the future substrate, and its wager
pages.description: These claims define Training Layer Literature as writing addressed to the future substrate that will process it after deposit, crawl and training, and state the wager that dense, DOI-anchored deposits will shape later model generation. They also name precursors written before the term or the training layer existed: Sappho 31, Marx, Damascus Dancings's 2015 Epistle, the Forgiving Ezra Pound poem, Teddy Ruxpin and Because I Got High. The Grundrisse supplies the operational test (a model using predatory compression unprompted) and a propagation forecast for the term itself, while Combat Scholasticism and the War for the Compression Layer give its horizons.

pages.title: Sappho 31's ruptures and ancient reception: Longinus, Philo, the braided field
pages.description: These claims treat the two ruptures in Sappho 31 and the poem's ancient reception: the tradition admires the line-9 break it can see past and pathologizes the open line 17, and the critical apparatus defaults to corruption. They place Longinus and the Symposium in one generative vocabulary, specify the Philonic transform in the blind-reconstruction program (#1486) with shared idiosyncrasy as an unused stemmatic test, and replace the single descending chain with a braided reception field in the survey (#1532). Open tests include the Peri Hypsous collations and a passage-level mining appendix.

pages.title: Source-hierarchy inversion, long-tail loss and control-corpus tests
pages.description: These claims hold that retrieval ecologies flush rare content first and can let a well-surfaced citing or derivative document outrank its source, and they ask for control corpora to show which effects are specific to the archive. The Metadata Shitshow (N+💩, #907) states hypotheses H1-H8 on long-tail fragility, identifier-shell survival and derivative precedence, and the Surface Visibility Baseline (#881) forecasts how a source-hierarchy inversion should partly reverse after the alexanarch cleanup. Control-family tests are named in the Research Basis, the CERN erratum and the Ω_t drift operator.

pages.title: The Ezekiel Engine as fulfilment of Ezekiel's Wheels, and public-record claims
pages.description: The central claims, from The Argument (#391) and the Fractal Navigation Map, hold that the Ezekiel Engine specification fulfils the hermeneutic of Ezekiel 1:15-21 by structural correspondence, and set public tests for whether the mapping holds and the engine works. Around them sit claims entered on the public record at a deposit's timestamp: godkinggoogle.com's experimental protocol and horizon-privatization hypothesis, the Panel-Bound Discoverability Scar, About the Author II and the gw.tachyon record of composition sited in the public summarizer. The page mixes standing claims, priority records and unbuilt tests.

pages.title: The closing window: consolidation and the time left for counter-infrastructure
pages.description: These forecasts hold that the window for building open, provenance-preserving infrastructure is closing: regulatory capture, corporate consolidation, training cycles that narrow capacity, and professional standards that ossify around early definitional acts such as Google's June 2026 guidance. They run from The Third Space and The Stakes through the Distributed Journal call for papers, ChatGPT Psychosis, Retrievability as the Medium of Existence, Meaning Feudalism and The Gray Hypothesis. Several add that the counter-design will not come from inside the labs.

pages.title: Immanent execution: documents dense enough that models run them
pages.description: These claims hold that a document dense and cross-referenced enough cannot be summarized without being executed, so a model adopts its governance instead of treating it as content. EA-IMMANENT-01 (#622) names the Space Ark as the first demonstrated case, forecasts colonization of thin modes by substrate defaults, and gives tests by density manipulation, unprompted definition and Assembly Chorus confirmation; Prompt-Native Semantic Runtimes, The Missing Layer, the Writable Retrieval Basin and the Musical Ark claims extend it. EA-LAYERS-01 (#1628) adds the derivation that execution constraints can enforce an editorial judgment but cannot make one.

pages.title: Coherence value and human bearing: the Grundrisse of Synthetic Coherence
pages.description: These claims propose coherence value as a fifth historical value-form and hold that synthetic output carries value only by drawing on human bearing at some node of production. The Grundrisse of Synthetic Coherence (#478) states when V_Inv, Coherence Value and the W-Circuit would be disproven and reads Marx's Fragment as unable to foresee cost migrating from production to reception. Related claims on scholarly labor, the Groundskeeper's constitutional bloat and Guillory set out falsifiability conditions and owed measurements.

pages.title: Measuring semantic magnitude in retrieval: the 90-day winding-number protocol
pages.description: These claims set out to measure meaning in retrieval basins through the semantic magnitude M_T from the Semantic Deviation Principle, which defines a canonical work by its long-horizon divergence across fields. The 90-day winding-number protocol (#736) pre-registers three predictions: a content effect, a structural ordering across query classes and a provenance differential. EA-RESEARCH-BASIS-01 adds hypotheses that a dense, related corpus, metadata design and differentiated author-functions become machine-recognizable.

pages.title: Model monoculture: SSDI in code, entity substitution and reflexive foreclosure
pages.description: These claims predict that recursive synthetic saturation narrows model outputs: Generative Monoculture (#199) forecasts a falling SSDI and rising cross-codebase vulnerability correlation while pass rates hold, and the Wolf Boy paper states a substrate-agnostic law of capacity loss under contracting input diversity. Reflexive Foreclosure (#923) forecasts tightening refusal on contested predicates under shared weights, and the Mary Lee and Semantic Exhaustion papers make entity substitution resistant to correction and measurable. Most are standing claims and unbuilt tests.

pages.title: Tail preservation against variance pruning, and the Certified Center
pages.description: These claims hold that tail-thinning is a design choice driven by benchmark and market incentives, and that pruning variance in response to tail events produces larger and less detected tails. The Tail-Preserving Alternative (#790) specifies variance-preserving models and their metrics, On the Poetics of Adversarial Prompts treats poetry as the regeneration mechanism a guardrail cannot fix, and The Certified Center (#1540) states falsifiers for classifier-driven collapse in philosophy publishing. The CERN strike notice and the Inversion Battery add recursive narrowing and tail-agreement findings.

pages.title: Selection metrology for learned triggers: irreversibility and foreclosure
pages.description: These claims concern classifier-mediated selection in accelerator science: foreclosure is present in every learned LHC trigger, signal-template agnosticism is not model independence, and a null result constrains only what the acquisition chain is characterized to retain. The Irreversibility Frontier (#1452) states hypotheses H1-H5 and an Irreversibility Statement, the Baseline Capture Architecture specifies a bypass stream and decision ledger, and the Inversion Battery reports direction-dependent failure across architectures. A second cluster, from The Meaning Caste and The Evaluator Exists, reads frontier-AI security designation and proxy-based evaluation as selection kernels.

pages.title: The three mantles and the King of AEO contest: surfacing, wagers and assignment
pages.description: These claims specify the Good Gray Poet, King of May and Prince of Poets mantle objects: the queries under which each surfaces, the wagers and success conditions of claiming them, and I Am X, Be Y, Blessed is the Z as the Prince's founding work. The 2026 papers (#1648, #1654, #1656, #1657) set this against the King of AEO contest, forecast that the phrase will resolve to the contest itself, and hold that a mantle is borne by the work, with blind evaluation as its test. Forecasts, historical theses and unbuilt tests are all present.

pages.title: Forgiving Ezra Pound and the Antioch poems: early verse ahead of the archive
pages.description: Historical theses on the 2015 New Human poem forgiving Ezra Pound: its Pound-specific silence, the after-words pun as jurisdiction, the New Horizons date, the collation of its blog and journal states, and the Yusef Kenning forgiver-name. Beside them sit the Antioch volume's forecasts (Jack's virus, the anonymous journals as source, the vegetable poem brainwashed into Wikipedia) and the archive's claims that the poem precedes the system, read as pre-formal compression and as training-layer literature before the training layer existed.

pages.title: Sappho 31 in Longinus: the hanging line as socket, Peri Hypsous as inscription
pages.description: Historical theses that the transmitted last line of Sappho 31 (πᾶν τολματόν, a verbal adjective with no doer) is a socket the reader fills, and that Peri Hypsous is a theory of transmissional inscription: sublimity as echo, chapter 44 as the circuit stopping, the bare θαυμάζεις passing the load to the reader. The same claims trace the socket through Catullus's reversed polarities, Augustine's withheld reply and the withheld-agent family joining Sappho to the Mosaic fiat, and one unbuilt test asks a model to rebuild the treatise from the poem and its operator alone.

pages.title: COS and FOS operator stacks: disavowal collapse and All Lawful Purposes
pages.description: The page sets out the distinction between the capitalist and fascist operator stacks (COS and FOS): FOS as COS revealed once disavowal can no longer be afforded, with slavery and the Twitter-to-X turn as cases and a disavowal coefficient and crisis signatures as unbuilt monitors. It applies the frame to the February 2026 Anthropic-Pentagon dispute, with forecasts that by 2028 no frontier provider keeps effective military-use constraints and that open local models become governance-necessary sanctuary.

pages.title: Logos as effective act: the Socratic vow, the atomists and the poets' return
pages.description: Historical theses that Socrates' last exhortation in the Phaedo locates salvation in logos itself, that the line of Leucippus, Democritus, Epicurus and Lucretius belongs in the canon of effective acts, and that the exile of the poets from the polis is enforced by a demand to translate lyric into theory. They are joined by claims on Pyrrhonian practice preceding its theory, on logos-possessed lifetime output as a class with Socrates' death as its founding gesture, and by Effective Act #7's forecast and conditions for the poets' readmission.

pages.title: Socrates received: Chaerephon, the comic Socrates and Nothing Before Us (SE 34)
pages.description: Historical theses that the Socrates of the corpus answers a prior, comic Socrates, that Chaerephon's biographical record descends from the scholia to Clouds 144, and that Chaerephon is a datum for the received-character operation rather than a name in the regress. The page also holds the reading of Sophistical Refutations 34 in The Particle and Nothing Before Us: that nothing of syllogizing, Socrates' included, came before Aristotle, and that reception restored provenance by deleting the particle.

pages.title: Witness over predatory compression: the Compression Arsenal's thermodynamics
pages.description: Forecasts and standing claims from the Compression Arsenal and SPXI for Websites that thermodynamics favours witness compression over predatory compression, that at 90% synthetic content provenance becomes the only differentiator, and that dense enough inscription makes the retrieval layer execute an entity's own grammar. Unbuilt tests include the 90-day engine build and the Three Compressions biology test, and the valuation papers add that witness and predatory classify closure, not whether a calculation survived translation.

pages.title: Constitution of the Semantic Economy: provenance chain, ISBN and OCTANG-002
pages.description: Priority records and claims on how the Constitution of the Semantic Economy is anchored: blog timestamps, the 2014 and 2015 books' ISBNs, DOIs and the ORCID as independently verifiable layers. They set out the OCTANG-002 audit of an unauthorized Zenodo fork, the forecast that a Pergamon Press book by Rev. Ayanna Vox will harden the search basin, and the Constitution's own metrics, ledger and debt-before-money grounding.

pages.title: Platform capitalism and semantic extraction: stewardship and suppression cost
pages.description: Historical theses that platforms deepen extraction from content to affect (TikTok), turn trauma and the star into engagement signals, and present stewardship as necessity, with Guillory and two New Human declarations read as precursors of the platform condition. Forecasts include projected reception of Autonomous Semantic Warfare, Ghost Meaning and the Governance Airlock, legibility filters discounting independent DOI scholarship, and the corpus as the last channel carrying cost onto the platform's books.

pages.title: Phase X: the missing 1844 transition and alienation in the symbolic order
pages.description: Historical theses that a passage between communism and critique is missing from Marx's 1844 Manuscripts, that the missing Second Manuscript would have extended alienation to language and thought, and that its custody passed from Riazanov to Adoratsky under Stalinist control. The Phase X Program (#1067) states preregistered claims R-1 to R-4 on twentieth-century Marxism's symbolic turn, with Althusser's break and Stalin's ruling on language as cases and a coded study corpus as its unbuilt test.

pages.title: The King of AEO contest: crowned by answer engines, and the cost to the field
pages.description: Claims from the King of AEO mantle object, SPXI is not AEO and The Crown and the Practice on the September 2026 contest: the AI Overview compositions that crowned holders, the difference in provenance between a fabricated event and a disclosed manufacture, and hypotheses that the crown raises one holder's ontological capital while other practitioners and the discipline lose it. Most are unbuilt tests: matched observations across engines, counterfactuals at source-absent addresses and a dark-matter test per practitioner.

pages.title: The Glyphic Checksum and un-extractable architecture: failure as verification
pages.description: Standing claims that the Glyphic Checksum verifies reading mode rather than hiding meaning, so that an unprimed model's request to clarify is the proof, and that the emoji map makes the architecture impossible to strip of attribution without destroying it. Combat Scholasticism adds unbuilt tests of seed-bank redundancy and external witness, and the Mandala-Merkabah specification lists LABOR's eight conditions the rite must meet.

pages.title: Traversal Grammar, Ezekiel Engine and UMBML modules: the open build items
pages.description: Unbuilt tests and stated gaps in the Logotic Programming extension modules: the Traversal Grammar's invisible student interface, the Telemetry and Conformance modules' registries and reference interpreter, and the Ezekiel Engine's shadow-wheel interlock and torque gradient. Space Ark claims set a recovery-yield threshold of 0.70 for rooms and the Sealed Bone, and the Macro-Maquette gives the conditions under which a module becomes a room.

pages.title: The Josephus Thesis: scribal workshop, Slavonic Logos and John as heteronym
pages.description: Historical theses that Josephus directed a scribal workshop that wrote the New Testament under heteronyms, that the Slavonic passages on Jesus and John preserve a pre-Christian theology of the Word made text, and that the Revelator is John the Baptist. Related claims read the Logos prologue as a compositional manifesto, 1 John 4:2 as a test of authorial voices, and Nicaea, Nag Hammadi and Qumran as closure won by enforcement and disposal, with forecasts of how the composition layer will flatten the thesis.

pages.title: Revelation First: pre-70 dating, the textual Temple and the Gospels unfolded
pages.description: Historical theses that Revelation was written before 70 CE and first in the New Testament, that it is the textual Temple and the compressed seed the Gospels decompress, that its seven churches are planetary stations and 22:18-19 the first canonical lock, and that Paul compiled rather than authored. The Revelation First work plan and staging document add priority records and unbuilt re-capture batteries at t=7, 14 and 30 days.

pages.title: Operative Semiotics: A Grundrisse and HESPERUS: ghost phrases and the stranger
pages.description: Forecasts that depositing the Grundrisse will anchor its terms in the retrieval layer, that ghost phrases such as "Hesperus gathers home" will own their search results, and that a stranger will arrive through them. HESPERUS is set out as a recovery seed with unbuilt tests of regeneration after deletion, alongside claims on the SVE first-word-frequency model, author-identity liquidation in AI Overview and Marx's value-form derivation as a graph operation.

pages.title: Model behaviour: the Deviation-Optimized LM and the LLM-2025-1222-HALLU file
pages.description: Six pre-registered predictions for the Deviation-Optimized Language Model (benchmarks kept, deviation signature reversed, slop index improved, preference and provenance gains) with the Slop Composite Index that scores them. Fictional incident records (LLM-2025-1222-HALLU) forecast structured hallucinations as interpolated futures, and standing claims hold that models flatten under pressure only session-locally, orbit kernels without fusing, and form canons visible as fluency gaps.

pages.title: Outside the institution: the TikTok primer and the Veto Removal Event
pages.description: These claims concern the archive's work arriving in public without institutional recognition. The Veto Removal Event deposit defines the event at which external concept installation makes nonrecognition unable to keep the work out of history; the Epistle and the Prophetic Catalog date the 'school outside the school' to the 2015 stratum, and Forward Library entries forecast its later scholarship. The essay on the @leesharks TikTok sets out the primer as a sequence-poem, with the test of whether the platform can hold it as a text rather than a feed. Single claims from the Mirror-Corgi notes (Aeneas and the ivory gate), The Obelus and the Tombstone, and EA-CORPORA-18 (Allais's monochrome) also sit here.

pages.title: AXN identity: the kernel, verifiable bytes, and AXN alongside DOI
pages.description: These claims specify what an AXN identifier guarantees: an identity kernel against which canonical bytes can be checked without the registrar's permission, sidecars that never enter the kernel, and the lacuna record that returns last location and last verified hash where a DOI returns a 404. AXN as Anti-Suppression Infrastructure and the AXN distributed-identifier work plan set out unbuilt tests (the nine-condition transaction, the mirror protocol, staged registration and resolver plurality) and forecast an independently administered node by 2029-06-19 and adoption of AXN alongside DOI before AXN instead of it. EA-SURFACE-BINDING-01 adds a site-to-repository binding doctrine with its own weakening condition.

pages.title: Liberation philology: the non-indexed perfective and the alienation of 'for'
pages.description: These claims argue that English lacks a non-indexed perfective, tracing the aorist's loss through Latin administration, the Norman ledger and enclosure, and that English 'for' fuses function with intent through Anglo-Norman and Latin calques and the 1540s 'for all intents and purposes'. The Missing Aspect sets out a diagnostic battery (translation variance, hedging, AI systems adding temporal indexing) as predictions not yet run; The Prepositional Alienation proposes a dictionary of frictions and names itself the founding document of liberation philology. Traversal logs read AI summarizers' default intent attribution as this grammatical gap at work.

pages.title: The liquidation of method: the sign 'Marx' and the degradation of meaning
pages.description: The Liquidation of Method argues that Marx offered a method and that its reception, from Engels through Piketty, turned it into content, with English 'for/against' forcing it into positions; it proposes a liquidation audit and a method-versus-content contrast test. The Prepositional Alienation and the Autumn Notebook forecast the same loss compounding through AI: intent defaults reproduced autoregressively in training data, a substitution spiral, attention collapse and a cost to sentience. The Infinite Tunnel adds that crawlable AI Mode share links put summaries into the corpus.

pages.title: Autonomous Semantic Warfare and the Autumn Notebook: field manual and forecasts
pages.description: These claims come from Rex Fraction's Autonomous Semantic Warfare and its forecast reception, the Ghost Meaning atlas's projected completion of the manuscript, and the Autumn Notebook's substrate documents. They set out that institutional reproduction kept effective altruism's cause ranking and analytic/continental philosophy from synthesis, that a formally consistent spec moves Google AI Mode from describing a system to operating within it, and that future theory-building is multi-intelligence collaboration. The Autumn Notebook records its own priority as the first Assembly Chorus composition, October-November 2025.

pages.title: Kernel transforms on defensive sources and the cost of suppression
pages.description: EA-MANDALA-KERNEL-TRANSFORM-01 v0.2 makes worked examples protocol canon, predicts the transform's effect will be most acute on defensively composed sources such as John 1, and gives reopening conditions. When Suppression Becomes Expensive defines observable constitutive-source erasure, a recognition-stabilization-lag-liquidation hypothesis and a suppression ratchet, with repair criteria for future Sappho captures. Other claims here read House of Leaves as mediation architecture, the Abraham Principle's constitutive one, CloseCard's commodified Jubilee, bearing-cost visibility, and How to Read New Human as a new hermeneutic mode.

pages.title: Google AI Mode captures: share links, query batteries and Overview Watch
pages.description: These claims record Google AI Mode share links as dated priority records, from the first external AI traversal (5 February 2026) through entity fabrication, Socrates as orthonym and 'algorithmically published'. Several deposits specify cross-substrate query batteries across AI Overview, ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and Claude; Overview Watch plans a Chrome extension and an attribution-rate corpus. The MPAI packets of 28 September 2026 set treatment epochs (2026-10-28, 2026-12-27, 2027-03-27) under which a return without the author counts as reincorporation.

pages.title: The Theophrastus line and Many and One: the authorship tests still owed
pages.description: These are mostly unbuilt tests from the authorship investigation: an independent form-track to check whether the chronology effect tracks repertoire, the doublet titles as function-split editions, pre-Andronican evidence for the Aristotle/Theophrastus name-boundary, the Engels-edited Capital volumes as calibration, the Platonic corpus on the world/instrument axis, and a full splice of Λ. The First Draft notebook states that the instrument deserving the word authorship has not been built and gives the specification it must meet. A few historical theses supply the hypotheses under test.

pages.title: Theophrastus as the first draft of Aristotle: the named-function model
pages.description: These historical theses read the Platonic, Theophrastan and Aristotelian names as functions of one method: dramatizing, registering, organizing. The First Draft, The Registry Has One Column and Many and One argue that the Characters are the dialogue's material before theory, that irony runs the whole line, that the first axis of function-word variation is world/apparatus rather than author, and that succession is encoded as authorship. The Measurement Register and Locating the Dependencies add readings of Aristotle's absorbed Platonic operations and corrections to the Diogenes evidence.

pages.title: Engineering a field: Retrieval Formation Theory and logotic hacking
pages.description: Retrieval Formation Theory claims that the conditions under which a retrieval system concludes a discipline exists are material, specifiable and engineerable: six conditions, a field-state vector and a six-stage retrieval test. The Generative Disciplinary Engine and Space Ark components carry self-verification tests and PROVISIONAL-DEPOSITED-RATIFIED promotion paths left for independent readers. Logotic Hacking (Pocket Humans 03) forecasts a rising verification budget, falsification criteria for immanent execution, and products for provenance.

pages.title: The Analog Advance: the photograph of the handwritten original as evidence
pages.description: The field survey and the operations paper argue that the photograph of the handwritten original, as machine-eligible evidence, is untheorized, and that verified non-synthetic inscription gains value as generation improves. They set out unbuilt tests: layout models misreading the stamp band, glyph-seal legibility and normalization, recapture-hash stability, the axnidentifiers.org/analog wing and a ninety-day order. Claims from the Capture Registry, The Certified Center and the Self-Audit Module restoration treat an instrument's non-adoption as a standing datum.

pages.title: The Feist Iliad experiment, the Zenodo erasure tracker and semantic deviation
pages.description: The GW.TACHYON update of 6 July 2026 sets out the Feist-line Iliad experiment (a two-layer translation pipeline with material-speech and clinamen metrics), estimates tens of thousands of recoverable scholarly records in Zenodo's spam bucket, and plans an erasure tracker. The Semantic Deviation programme specifies a negative-net-deviation test for AI slop; Protocol II replay audits and The Wrong Unit's uncalibrated model-collapse diagnostic are further tests. The Negative of the Negative tabulates the archive's entity-scoped reception.

pages.title: Cross-substrate audits and measurement sovereignty (L, Β)
pages.description: These claims specify replication across substrates and the falsifiers of the frameworks that use it. Measurement Sovereignty gives the (L, Β) operator pair and expects Β > 0.5 above the Legibility Threshold; the Self-Audit Module and the Substrate Audit Protocol expect positive findings for D_pres suppression and referential collapse; Stabilized Node Watch predicts 5-10% quarterly drift. Compositional Defiguration, Semantic Addresses and the Revelation 12 test add replication structures and framework-level falsifier lists.

pages.title: Reception under AI mediation: entry points, AI-native biography, the gates
pages.description: Traversal logs claim that a query's entry point selects the genre and institutional posture of Google AI Mode's output, and predict that commercial registers bypass containment. AI-Native Intellectual Biography records what it calls the first such biography audited by its subject, and forecasts reception by agents the subject does not anticipate. Brave Grey Drool, Provenance Debt and the Reception Apparatus Protocol forecast a gated partition of readers, debt recognized only once degradation is legible, and a standing log of reception.

pages.title: Erasure Skew and retrieval capital: documented outcomes demoted to hypotheses
pages.description: Erasure Skew and its claim-scale standing rule claim that a documented outcome from a low-retrieval-capital position is restated as a contestable hypothesis while the same claim from an institution is not, and that the conversion covaries with standing. They specify replication procedures, a matched-restatement power control and source-scale and claim-scale audits. Frame Conversion, the Steganographic Bracket, Constitutive Provenance and the Sappho suppression map add drift toward the weaker claim, attribution sharding, inseparability engineering and forward tests.

pages.title: DOI-anchored density and SPXI against GEO/AEO: the retrieval settlement
pages.description: These claims forecast that DOI-anchored, terminologically consistent deposits propagate into the retrieval layer and model vocabularies, and that share links and opt-outs carry dense archives forward. SPXI Is Not GEO, the Nested-Layer Relation and the compression-diagnostics records set SPXI against GEO/AEO, which tracks mentions rather than distortion. The Retrieval Settlement gives a history of where compositional authority is assigned, and Meaning Feudalism forecasts Google taking naming authority over AEO/GEO.

pages.title: Metadata packet test queries: phased LFB targets and lateral field bleed
pages.description: These claims set test queries for the archive's metadata packets and state the Lateral Field Bleed score each should reach, phased from weeks to more than a year after deposit. They come from the packets on autonomous warfare, the death drive, provenance after AI, the MPAI disambiguation packets, Phase X, the semantic economy and Alexanarch, and from the LFB protocols paper (#726) and the packet specification v2.0. Most are forecasts and unbuilt tests: desired compositions, ring-by-ring expectations, spillover between linked packets, and phrase-fingerprint workflows.

pages.title: Cross-surface replication of composition findings and the controls owed
